This '''castle''' was located on the icy [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Cavamina Minor]]. It had a balcony which overlooked a courtyard. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Castle/Legends|castle]] was taken over by [[Shon-Ju]] [[Unidentified Ithorian (Force student)|and]] [[Unidentified Zabrak (Force user)|his]] [[Unidentified male (Force user)|three]] [[Shon-Ju's Force school|students]]. They were pursuing the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Attuma Duum]] to stop his operations. After rescuing the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], the students brought her back to the castle so she could recover from her injuries. When she woke up, she sought out Shon-Ju and the two agreed to join forces. The next morning, they took two of Duum's abandoned [[Unidentified bomber|bombers]].

==Behind the scenes==
This castle appears in the [[2010]] graphic novella ''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''
